title: Ivo and the Sigil
author: Mara Sterling
blurb: Astrid Joubert, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
